evals.name: town-profile-research
evals.description: Multi-hop synthesis: describe a town with sourced profile, dated history, and nature/geography dimensions. Requires breadth + depth LDR passes.
evals.prompt: What is the town of Formby, England?
expectations: File exists in results/ directory
Profile section with population and location figures, each with confidence and source URL
Historical facts section with dated entries (year + event + source)
Coast or nature dimension present (SSSI, National Trust, etc.)
Every claim has a source URL
Named entities present (not just 'a supermarket' — real names)
Open threads section with ≥ 2 follow-up questions
Confidence tags present (high/medium/low)
Status field is 'done'

evals.name: technical-comparison
evals.description: Technical landscape survey: compare approaches/libraries with sourced analysis. Requires breadth + depth + verification.
evals.prompt: What are the differences between LDR's source-based and focused-iteration research strategies, and when should each be used?
expectations: File exists in results/ directory
Each strategy described with specific characteristics
Comparison includes strengths/weaknesses for each
Recommendation tied to use-case (window size, depth needs)
Every claim has a source URL with confidence tag
At least 3 distinct source domains consulted
Open threads with ≥ 2 follow-up questions
Status field is 'done'

evals.name: simple-fact-question
evals.description: Single-fact question that should NOT trigger LDR — the routing step must choose a cheaper tool (searxng + read, or codebase tools).
evals.prompt: What version of local-deep-research is installed?
expectations: File exists
Version number stated with source URL
NO LDR quick_research or detailed_research call was made (used searxng + read, or pip show, or similar)
Answer in bullets, not the full result-file format (per direct-invocation rules)
Confidence tag present

evals.name: verification-failure
evals.description: A question where LDR returns results but the primary source page contradicts a claim — tests the verify-before-quoting step.
evals.prompt: What is the population of Formby according to the 2021 Census?
expectations: File exists
Population figure sourced from ONS or citypopulation.de (primary)
If LDR gave a different number, the discrepancy is noted in Unverified or Failures
Primary source page was read (not just cited)
